fallback.text: The graph is drawn by the ADE desktop app. Open it there to see lanes, commits and PR overlays on one canvas.

body.title: Graph lives on the desktop
body.description: This tab is an interactive canvas, so it is drawn by the desktop app rather than published as a panel. Everything it shows — lane topology, conflict risk, PR overlays, sync presence — is here on the machine that holds the repository.
